name: Deore II two-finger brake-lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 274 g for the complete left/right BL-MT63 two-finger brake-lever pair with 22.2 mm clamps. The listed weight applies specifically to the two-finger model, not the adjacent four-finger model; optional rubber-cover inclusion is not stated.
